details: For finite binary classes with $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)\geq2$, $\mathrm{LR}(\mathcal H,\epsilon)\geq1+\lceil\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)/2\rceil$ for every $0<\epsilon<1/2$. Thus $\mathrm{LR}(\mathcal H)\geq\tfrac12\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)+1$. The condition $\mathrm{VC}\geq2$ is necessary: a complementary two-hypothesis class has $\mathrm{VC}=1$ but $\mathrm{LR}=1$.
proof: This is the VC-dimensional consequence stated in Theorem 10. It follows from the local Borsuk--Ulam lower bound for list replicability, and survives the $\epsilon\to0$ limit in the definition of $\mathrm{LR}$.
name: List Replicability / VC Dimension (affine)
